name: k9b_observe
_comment: K9 wave 4: bracket colour of one armed AI Subject Disc (AI 2 or AI 4, hostile or not) at Kit Port. The player (Kit Lancer Heavy, IFF, Kit Tickler) targets it once with Tab (with one other ship Tab toggles, so only once), shoots every 2.5 s for 15 s, tickles it once (Space 0.6 s), then shoots every 2.5 s for 60 s. Pilots w4_k9b_{ai2,ai4h,ai4r,ai4n}.
